Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning fish passage enhancement projects by the department of transportation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fish passage enhancement projects by thedepartment of transportation; adding a new section to chapter 47.04RCW; adding a new section to chapter 43.21C RCW; adding a new sectionto chapter 77.55 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 90.58 RCW; addinga new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter35A.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 36.70 RCW; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For purposes of this section, "fish habitat enhancementproject" means a project designed according to the most recentstandards approved by the department of fish and wildlife to accomplishone or more of the following tasks: (a) Elimination of humanmade fish passage barriers, includingculvert repair and replacement; (b) Restoration of an eroded or unstable stream bank employing theprinciple of bioengineering, including limited use of rock as a p. 1 HB 2765stabilization only at the toe of the bank, and with primary emphasis onusing native vegetation to control the erosive forces of flowing water;or (c) Placement of woody debris or other instream structures thatbenefit naturally reproducing fish stocks. (2) The department of transportation must provide notice of eachfish habitat enhancement project to the department of fish andwildlife, which must provide notice to every appropriate tribe. (3) A local government may not require permits, require mitigation,or charge fees for a fish habitat enhancement project that meets thedefinition in subsection (1) of this section and that is constructedpursuant to this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For purposes of this section, "fish habitat enhancementproject" means a project designed according to the most recentstandards approved by the department of fish and wildlife to accomplishone or more of the following tasks: (a) Elimination of humanmade fish passage barriers, includingculvert repair and replacement; (b) Restoration of an eroded or unstable stream bank employing theprinciple of bioengineering, including limited use of rock as astabilization only at the toe of the bank, and with primary emphasis onusing native vegetation to control the erosive forces of flowing water;or (c) Placement of woody debris or other instream structures thatbenefit naturally reproducing fish stocks. (2) A fish habitat enhancement project that meets the definition insubsection (1) of this section is expected to result in beneficialimpacts to the environment. Decisions pertaining to a fish habitatenhancement project that meets the definition in subsection (1) of thissection are not subject to the requirements in RCW 43.21C.030(2)(c). (3) A local government or state agency may not require mitigationfor a fish habitat enhancement project that meets the definition insubsection (1) of this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.55 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For purposes of this section, "fish habitat enhancementproject" means a project designed according to the most recentstandards approved by the department of fish and wildlife to accomplishone or more of the following tasks: (a) Elimination of humanmade fish passage barriers, includingculvert repair and replacement; (b) Restoration of an eroded or unstable stream bank employing theprinciple of bioengineering, including limited use of rock as astabilization only at the toe of the bank, and with primary emphasis onusing native vegetation to control the erosive forces of flowing water;or (c) Placement of woody debris or other instream structures thatbenefit naturally reproducing fish stocks. (2) A fish habitat enhancement project conducted by or for theWashington state department of transportation that complies withapplicable federal environmental review requirements or protectionrequirements, or both, does not require a permit under this chapter. (3) A local government or state agency may not require mitigationfor a fish habitat enhancement project that meets the definition insubsection (1) of this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.58 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For purposes of this section, "fish habitat enhancementproject" means a project designed according to the most recentstandards approved by the department of fish and wildlife to accomplishone or more of the following tasks: (a) Elimination of humanmade fish passage barriers, includingculvert repair and replacement; (b) Restoration of an eroded or unstable stream bank employing theprinciple of bioengineering, including limited use of rock as astabilization only at the toe of the bank, and with primary emphasis onusing native vegetation to control the erosive forces of flowing water;or (c) Placement of woody debris or other instream structures thatbenefit naturally reproducing fish stocks. p. 3 HB 2765 (2) Guidelines adopted by the department of ecology and masterprograms developed or amended by local governments in accordance withRCW 90.58.080 do not require modification of or limit a fish habitatenhancement project conducted by or for the Washington state departmentof transportation that complies with applicable federal environmentalreview requirements or protection requirements, or both. (3) A local government or state agency may not require mitigationfor a fish habitat enhancement project that meets the definition insubsection (1) of this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A city or town is not liable for adverse impacts resulting from afish habitat enhancement project that meets the criteria of section 1of this act and has been conducted by or for the department oftransportation.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A code city is not liable for adverse impacts resulting from a fishhabitat enhancement project that meets the criteria of section 1 ofthis act and has been conducted by or for the department oftransportation.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A county is not liable for adverse impacts resulting from a fishhabitat enhancement project that meets the criteria of section 1 ofthis act and has been conducted by or for the department oftransportation.
